request: overhead tank on the roof holds 1000 litres (a capacity i can change). every time the motor runs i add the litres filled, and when we use water i add what was used. draw the tank with the level, tell me litres left, and how many days it lasts at the average daily use
checklist: 4. days it lasts at average use
program:
app "Water tank" cup plum
table flow litres num 1..2000 = 100, kind pick Filled|Used = Used
setting capacity num = 1000 "Tank capacity (litres)"
let level = clamp(sum(flow.litres where kind = Filled) - sum(flow.litres where kind = Used), 0, capacity)
let daily = sum(flow.litres last 7 days where kind = Used) / 7
quick flow, litres, [50, 100, 200]
draw 120, 120 width 160
  rect 20, 10, 80, 100 fill soft radius 8
  rect 20, 110 - 100 * level / capacity, 80, 100 * level / capacity fill if(level / capacity < 0.2, bad, accent) radius 8
  label 60, 60, round(level * 100 / capacity) "%" big
row gap 1
  each options flow.kind
    button it tap add flow litres = 100, kind = it
statcard round(level), "litres left", capacity
"Lasts about" floor(level / max(daily, 1)) "days at" round(daily) "litres a day" bold
section "Used per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(flow.litres on it where kind = Used)

app "Rose cuttings" plant pink

table sale meat pick Beef|Mutton|Chicken|Liver = Beef, kg num 0.1..50, amount money
setting beef money = 1400 "Beef per kg"
setting mutton money = 2400 "Mutton per kg"
setting chicken money = 700 "Chicken per kg"
setting liver money = 1200 "Liver per kg"
state cut pick Beef|Mutton|Chicken|Liver = Beef
state kg num = 1

request: my sleep clinic wants proof I use the CPAP at least 4 hours a night on 70 percent of nights. I log the hours each morning. show the percent of nights in the last 30 days that reached 4 hours, average hours, a bar chart of the week with the 4 hour line and a nightly reminder at 22:00

request: sleep diary: when I went to bed, when I woke up and how rested I feel from 1 to 5. show last night's hours, the average of the week, my usual wake time and a bar chart of hours slept for the last 7 nights. reminder to go to bed at 22:30

let hrs(n night) = (n.woke - n.bed) / 1h
remind "Time to wind down for bed" at 22:30
topbar "Sleep diary", night, "Add night"
row gap 2
  statcard round(hrs(last(night)) * 10) / 10, "hours last night"

      n.bed "to" n.woke bold

request: I run broiler batches of 1000 chicks, about 40 days each. for a batch I want chick cost, feed bags used each week, and mortality count, then sale weight and rate. show feed cost and profit per batch so I know which batch was good

program:

      button "1 dead" tap add dead batch = b, birds = 1
